description: Descriptor of a VBA macro project preserved verbatim (node type x.gridcraft.vba). The project is the file `vbaProject.bin` of this node, byte for byte as it was in the source file. Its bytes are NOT a compound file, so this package carries no definition of them; they are kept only so that saving the workbook again does not destroy them. GridCraft does not run macros; the project is kept so that saving a macro-enabled workbook does not destroy its macros.

file_name.description: The file of this node that holds the project: the one whose path ends in `/vbaProject.bin`.

format.description: The bytes are in no format this package defines.

never_auto_execute.description: ALWAYS true, and not a switch: this node carries EMBEDDED CODE. A consumer MUST NOT execute, load, compile or interpret it automatically - not on open, not on preview, not on any event. Reading it as data (listing modules, showing source text) is not executing it. Running it is a deliberate act of a person who has inspected it, outside this format.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the project's bytes.

size.description: Size of the project in bytes.

title: x.gridcraft.vba - a VBA project preserved verbatim, never executed
